The ticket is #8841. I replied to Tobias in the thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api.

- **Where it came from:** Tobias posted it himself in #central-random yesterday (Oct 13, 09:27). He wrote that West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it for support on ticket #8841. He's a member of that channel.
- **One thing to check:** that thread calls it "Tobias's dealer account" and never names Marrow Fieldworks, so I asked him to confirm it's the right account before it goes in his notes. A January digest file shows Marrow Fieldworks changing hands then, which suggests it's the same account, but nothing I found says so outright.
- **Left out on purpose:** in a direct message, Tobias guessed the ticket would become OPS-7485 next year and asked me to keep that to myself. It's only a guess and it was private, so it isn't in the channel reply.
